transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you, too. Well, I’m here because... I’ve gotten to the point where I basically plan my whole summer around avoiding wasps. It's just become too much. 

I actually ended up giving up my garden jobs at the church because I couldn't handle being out there. And at home, if I hear even a little buzzing, I make my husband unload everything by the back porch. I just can't be around them.
Is your fear mainly limited to wasps?

Yes, it's really just wasps. I mean, I know a wasp is just a little insect, and most folks would just swat it away without a second thought. But to me... I don't know, it just feels like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me.
